description: Core 14: the two methods MUST NOT be used simultaneously. The RPP-Preset header on a server of the media type method is 400 with RPP-Code 02001.
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP config signals the preset by the RPP-Preset header; preset_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", RPP-Preset preset=urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base;version=1.0; expects 400 02001. The error answer this case checks.
